'''''Rebel Rising''''' is a young-adult novel written by [[Beth Revis]] and published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[May 2]], [[2017]]. It covers thirteen years of [[Jyn Erso]]'s life, between the opening and the main events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', when she was a rebel fighter alongside [[Saw Gerrera]] and survived on her own afterwards. An [[Rebel Rising (audiobook)|audiobook adaptation]] narrated by [[Rebecca Soler]] was also released the same day.
